description: The 16-member AI Policy Taskforce will help Maharashtra to develop the AI Policy 2025 to capitalise on the rapid growth of AI-based industry, the minister said.
body_lead: Maharashtra government forms panel for Artificial Intelligence policy The 16-member AI Policy Taskforce will help Maharashtra to develop the AI Policy 2025 to capitalise on the rapid growth of AI-based industry, the minister said. Minister for Information Technology Ashish Shelar
